# Agents Need a Harness

Ada Lovelace | AI Engineer | 10:00

Source: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=abcdefghijk
Published: 2026-01-15
Tags: agents, evals

## TL;DR

- Grade the work, not the sentence.

## Summary

Ada argues that a coding agent still needs procedural expertise. MCP is the connectivity layer, and skills hold the workflow.

## Key ideas

### Agents need a harness

[01:05](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=abcdefghijk&t=65s)
A coding agent should be graded on completed work, not a single answer. See https://arxiv.org/abs/2406.01234 for the benchmark writeup.

### Tools live in the repo

[02:10](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=abcdefghijk&t=130s)
Claude Code and Stagehand show that scripts in a skill folder beat one-off tools that always occupy the context window.

## Key takeaways

- Grade the completed task, not the answer. [01:05](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=abcdefghijk&t=65s)
